% A macro that wraps \title with a blank line before its argument, in a
% report with a title page. The document builds, and the page's title
% holds the text.
\documentclass[titlepage]{report}
\newcommand\settitle[1]{\title{

#1}}
\settitle{Heading text}
\author{Someone}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
Some text.
\end{document}
